paragraphs.text: Enrolment opens on 12 January at the college reception and online. Courses start in the week beginning 3 February and run for ten weeks. Each class lasts two hours.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The standard fee is £150, with a reduced fee of £95 for people over 60. Learners who miss more than three classes cannot receive a certificate. Parking is free after 6 pm in car park B.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: On what date does enrolment open?
How long does each class last?
What is the fee for a learner aged 65?
In which car park is parking free in the evening?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
